items.content_html: A lightweight utility for Node.js projects that accumulates items into fixed-size batches per key, preserving insertion order within each key. items.content_html: LusoPronounce is a lightweight, offline-friendly Portuguese pronunciation training app utilizing Azure AI's Pronunciation Assessment. The app generates sentences, words, and pronunciation tips; stores history with MongoDB; and provides a simple UI for practicing speaking, getting feedback, and improving over time through spaced repetition.
